title: Qingre Huoxue decoction and its active compound Quercetin modulate bone remodeling by inhibiting ATF4 hyperactivation to attenuate bone erosion in rheumatoid arthritis.
authors: Xia, Congmin; Chang, Tian; Gong, Xun; Zhang, Fuyuan; Peng, Qiuwei; Song, Mengge; Yao, Chuanhui; Tang, Xiaopo; Jiang, Quan
journal: Journal of orthopaedic surgery and research
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方及槲皮素通过抑制ATF4过度活化调节骨重塑，虽涉及转录因子ATF4和分子对接，但核心是骨代谢疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is characterized by synovial inflammation and bone erosion driven by osteoblast-osteoclast imbalance. Qingre Huoxue decoction (QRHXD), a traditional Chinese medicine, alleviates RA symptoms, yet its mechanism in mitigating bone erosion remains unclear. METHODS: Network pharmacology identified active compounds and targets of QRHXD. Collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) rats were treated with QRHXD or Methotrexate. Arthritis severity (HE staining), bone microstructure (X-ray micro-CT), osteoblast/osteoclast markers (RT-qPCR, TRAP staining), and ATF4 expression (Western blot, immunofluorescence staining) were assessed. Primary osteoblasts from CIA rats were treated with QRHXD or its active compound to validate ATF4 modulation. RESULTS: QRHXD reduced joint swelling, arthritis scores, and bone loss in CIA rats, restoring trabecular parameters (Tb.N, Tb.Th, BV/TV) and suppressing bone resorption markers (TRAP, CTX-1, RANKL). Moreover, the number of osteoclast was significantly reduced. Protein interaction analysis highlighted ATF4 as a core regulator of bone remodeling and potentially regulated by the active compound Quercetin in QRHXD. Both QRHXD and Quercetin inhibited ATF4 hyperactivation in CIA osteoblasts, rebalancing RUNX2 and RANKL expression, with Quercetin showing greater efficacy. Molecular docking further exhibited strong binding affinity between Quercetin and the ATF4-regulating transcription factors RAD21, CBFB and HDAC2. CONCLUSION: QRHXD attenuates bone erosion in RA by inhibiting ATF4 hyperactivation via Quercetin, restoring osteoblast-osteoclast crosstalk.
abstract_zh: 背景：类风湿关节炎（RA）以滑膜炎症和由成骨细胞-破骨细胞失衡驱动的骨侵蚀为特征。清热活血方（QRHXD）是一种中药，可缓解RA症状，但其减轻骨侵蚀的机制仍不清楚。方法：网络药理学鉴定了QRHXD的活性化合物和靶点。胶原诱导性关节炎（CIA）大鼠接受QRHXD或甲氨蝶呤治疗。评估关节炎严重程度（HE染色）、骨微结构（X射线显微CT）、成骨细胞/破骨细胞标志物（RT-qPCR、TRAP染色）以及ATF4表达（Western blot、免疫荧光染色）。从CIA大鼠分离的原代成骨细胞用QRHXD或其活性化合物处理，以验证ATF4的调节作用。结果：QRHXD减轻了CIA大鼠的关节肿胀、关节炎评分和骨丢失，恢复了骨小梁参数（Tb.N、Tb.Th、BV/TV），并抑制了骨吸收标志物（TRAP、CTX-1、RANKL）。此外，破骨细胞数量显著减少。蛋白质相互作用分析突出显示ATF4是骨重塑的核心调节因子，并可能受QRHXD中活性化合物槲皮素（Quercetin）的调节。QRHXD和槲皮素均抑制了CIA成骨细胞中ATF4的过度激活，重新平衡了RUNX2和RANKL的表达，其中槲皮素显示出更强的效果。分子对接进一步显示槲皮素与ATF4调节转录因子RAD21、CBFB和HDAC2之间具有强结合亲和力。结论：QRHXD通过槲皮素抑制ATF4过度激活，恢复成骨细胞-破骨细胞相互作用，从而减轻RA中的骨侵蚀。
